MERGED: Gerrit change 1950 patchset 2 submitted at 2026-08-20 07:09:50, landed on main as 54469ca756. Votes at submit: LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot, PASS, no findings on PS2) and Verified +1 (rebar CI bot, https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/32340319547 SUCCESS), 0 unresolved comments.

PS1 carried two ADVISORY (non-blocking) LLM-Review findings, both addressed in PS2:
- _reconciler_main() left a sys.path entry behind. Kept the insert (it is the established house pattern, and popping it would strand a later import of a not-yet-loaded rebar_reconciler submodule) and documented that reasoning in the docstring.
- The empty-capture assertion message attributed the failure solely to 'no longer routes through the composer', but emit_shadow_snapshot deliberately swallows composer exceptions, so a RAISING composer produces the same empty capture. The message now names both causes — and says why the swallow is exactly what makes this external capture necessary. Re-confirmed after the reword: neutralising the MCP _shadow body still turns it RED with the new text; reverted -> 5 passed.

PS1's Verified -1 was its CI run being CANCELLED when PS2 superseded it, not a test failure.

Gates re-run on the amended, rebased tree: make lint pass, make typecheck Success (580 files), check_complexity_baseline.py --check -> active=49 new=0 increased=0 stale=0. CI's Verified +1 is the authoritative whole-tree signal on the exact landed commit.
